how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-felwood-03.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:5202:obj:0: Search through Jaedenar to discover what the ⟦E1⟧ is used for.
rows.quest:5202:details:0: The small red key seems to be made of some kind of bone material. It is heavy in your hand, but appears very fragile. Why would a member of the ⟦E2⟧ have such a thing? Perhaps there is something within Jaedenar that this strange key unlocks.
rows.quest:5202:progress:0: I begin to wonder if I'll ever escape this cage.⟦1⟧⟦2⟧It's only a matter of time before they sacrifice me to whatever demons they worship. The monsters!
rows.quest:5202:completion:0: The key, you've found it! Please, give it to me and I can finally escape!

rows.quest:5203:details:0: But, as much as it pains me, there is one thing that must be done first: I have to find Trey's sword Lightforge and escape ⟦E3⟧ Hold to tell my superiors what's happening here. Can you help me, ⟦3⟧?
rows.quest:5203:details:1: Our equipment isn't far from here, and you've already proven you can survive the path to the top.
rows.quest:5203:details:2: After we escape, I'll head to ⟦E5⟧ if you can find my friend Jessir near the ⟦E6⟧ border. She was to meet us at the ⟦E7⟧'s camp near there.
rows.quest:5203:details:3: What do you say, ⟦4⟧? Can you help me again?
rows.quest:5203:progress:0: You look winded, ⟦5⟧. Are you all right, or is something wrong?
rows.quest:5203:completion:0: You were the one who helped Arko escape? I'm so glad you found me. She passed by here not too long ago on her way to ⟦E5⟧. She had Lightforge in tow and wouldn't even take time to speak to the druids to be healed. She said it was far too urgent.
rows.quest:5203:completion:1: But she did tell me about your encounter with Trey's spirit. What a terrible fate for a Knight of the Silver Hand. She didn't show it, but I know it's tearing her up inside, the thought of losing one of her closest friends.

rows.quest:8462:obj:0: ⟦E11⟧ north along the main road in ⟦E4⟧ and speak with the furbolg named Nafien. He stands guard outside the entrance to ⟦E12⟧.
rows.quest:8462:details:0: Perhaps you are capable of handling a larger ⟦E13⟧ that we Timbermaw face. You certainly have shown yourself capable here...
rows.quest:8462:details:1: Another of my kind stands guard outside the entrance to ⟦E12⟧, along this road far to the north. His name is Nafien; while he may appear to be a feral and unsavory beast, ⟦E14⟧ him not. He only seeks aid against the malign forces that threaten our home.
rows.quest:8462:completion:0: Ah... I have heard the word on the wind about those not of our tribe who seek to ally themselves with the Timbermaw furbolgs. I welcome you, but you must be warned that my tribe reacts poorly to strangers.
rows.quest:8462:completion:1: These are trying times, and we can only trust those who choose to fight the corruption of the land alongside of us... and have proven themselves to us accordingly. Those who have not done so will be met with open hostility should they enter the Hold.
rows.quest:8465:obj:0: ⟦E11⟧ through ⟦E12⟧ and exit into ⟦E15⟧. Speak with Salfa, who stands guard outside the entrance to ⟦E12⟧.
rows.quest:8465:details:0: The ⟦E13⟧ of corruption comes not only from the ⟦E16⟧ furbolgs to the south, but also from the east and the Winterfall furbolgs of ⟦E15⟧. If you wish to further aid us, speak with Salfa on the other side of the Hold, by the ⟦E15⟧ entrance. Follow the path to the left to reach it.
rows.quest:8465:details:1: Be warned - if my kind inside considers you hostile or hated, they will attack. ⟦E11⟧ as quick as you can, avoiding conflict. To kill a Timbermaw - even in self defense - will only alienate you further.
rows.quest:8465:completion:0: Greetings, ⟦36⟧ - I stand guard here as both a speaker for the Timbermaw here in ⟦E15⟧ and as a defender of the tribe.
rows.quest:8465:completion:1: Our Winterfall brethren here in this frigid land have fallen under the same corruptive sway as the furbolg of ⟦E4⟧. If you've come here offering the Timbermaw furbolgs aid, then we are ready to accept such an offer.
rows.quest:8470:obj:0: Take the ⟦E17⟧ inside ⟦E12⟧ and see if one of the furbolgs there will find a use for the item. The Timbermaw will not speak with you unless you are of ⟦E18⟧ reputation or greater with them.
rows.quest:8470:details:0: You have found one of the ⟦E16⟧ furbolg's ritual totems. The ⟦E19⟧ itself is of non-descript construction, but a palpable sense of despair emanates from it. If there were any object that might best exemplify the corruption that the ⟦E16⟧ furbolg suffer under, this item would clearly be it.
rows.quest:8470:details:1: One of the furbolgs inside ⟦E12⟧ may have a use for such an item... that is, if you've earned their trust enough for them to speak with you.⟦37⟧
rows.quest:8470:progress:0: Yes ⟦38⟧, what can I assist you with? You walk among us peacefully, though there is assuredly something amiss. I sense something... something troubling...
rows.quest:8470:completion:0: This ⟦E19⟧... I recognize it as one of the ⟦E16⟧'s, but it is thick with the stench of decay. Whatever foulness has turned our brethren against us is surely present in this object.
rows.quest:8470:completion:1: You were wise to bring this to us, ⟦39⟧. Perhaps through study and ritual, we can uncover what it is that pollutes the minds of our brethren. Thank you, friend please accept these offerings in exchange for your find.
rows.quest:4261:obj:0: Escort Arei to safety, then speak with ⟦E20⟧ in Forest Song, in eastern ⟦E6⟧.
rows.quest:4261:details:0: ⟦E4⟧ was once a peaceful and serene land... Until the legion took hold. The infernals, destruction, chaos...
rows.quest:4261:details:1: The skull of Gul'dan ensured that none were spared here. All fell to the corruption.
rows.quest:4261:details:2: Even now, as a spirit, I still find myself trapped, bearing the suffering of this land. Help me find my way home. Please, ⟦40⟧, tell me you will lead an ancient spirit away from here, where I may finally rest.
rows.quest:4261:details:3: Once I am free, seek out ⟦E20⟧, a druid that resides in Forest Song, to the east.
rows.quest:4261:completion:0: Yes, ⟦41⟧. ⟦E4⟧ has been through much hardship. Thank you for what you have done.
rows.quest:4261:completion:1: One day, we may be able to reclaim ⟦E4⟧ from the corruption; every kind deed helps.
rows.quest:4521:obj:0: Trull Failbane in ⟦E4⟧ wants you to kill 15 Raging Owlbeasts and 15 Ragged Owlbeasts.
rows.quest:4521:details:0: ⟦E15⟧ lies just beyond Timbermaw, northeast of ⟦E4⟧. Have you been there?
rows.quest:4521:details:1: I have heard that the area is laden with creatures called wildkin. These beasts have been known to guard secrets; secrets of the ⟦E21⟧.
rows.quest:4521:details:2: We must figure out what may be hidden in ⟦E15⟧.
rows.quest:4521:details:3: I have heard the ragged owlbeasts can be found just south of the road, and that there are others called raging owlbeasts that may be found in the center of ⟦E15⟧. Clear them out, and gain access to the land.
rows.quest:4521:progress:0: Report back to me after you have completed the task I gave you.
rows.quest:4521:completion:0: This is excellent news, ⟦42⟧. With these beasts out of the way, we can begin to adventure further into ⟦E15⟧. Are you ready for more?
rows.quest:5249:obj:0: Find ⟦E22⟧ Village in ⟦E15⟧ and speak with Wynd Nightchaser.
rows.quest:5249:details:0: In ⟦E15⟧, to the north of here, there are many ancient elven ruins. It's a harsh land, but it holds many secrets and places to explore.
rows.quest:5249:details:1: With all my work to do here in ⟦E4⟧, I have not had the opportunity to travel to ⟦E15⟧. But there's no reason why you shouldn't!
rows.quest:5249:details:2: While you're there, look for Wynd Nightchaser. He spends most of his time in ⟦E22⟧ Village and he knows a lot about the area.
rows.quest:5249:completion:0: A friend of Ivy Leafrunner? Nice to meet you, ⟦43⟧.
rows.quest:5204:obj:0: Return to Jaedenar and kill the succubus Rakaiah before finding the ⟦E23⟧.
rows.quest:5204:details:0: She would like to pretend that she's fine. She'd love for me to think that she's strong enough to deal with all of this on her own, but I know better than that. Trey's death and hearing the torture he was put through is going to haunt her for a long time, and there's nothing we can do to stop that. But we can give her some peace!
rows.quest:5204:details:1: B⟦44⟧, return to ⟦E3⟧ Hold, kill Trey's torturer and find his remains. There is no reason we can't tie off all these loose ends while Arko'narin mourns in her own private way.
rows.quest:5204:progress:0: You inspect the body, and there is no doubt that these are the remains of the Knight of the Silver Hand, Trey Lightforge. For a moment you think of Arko'narin and question if anyone in your life meant as much to you as this man meant to the ⟦E24⟧ captive you recently helped escape ⟦E3⟧ Hold.⟦45⟧⟦46⟧After taking another moment to gather your thoughts, you know that you cannot take the paladin's remains back to Jessir without killing his torturer first.
rows.quest:5204:completion:0: You gather the paladin's remains as carefully as you can, recalling that at least his spirit has been released from any pain or suffering that might have been forced upon him.
rows.quest:5385:obj:0: Return the ⟦E23⟧ to Jessir Moonbow in ⟦E4⟧.
rows.quest:5385:details:0: You pick up the sack carefully and prepare to make your way back to Jessir Moonbow on the border of ⟦E4⟧ and ⟦E6⟧. Hopefully the paladin will be given the proper respects once you've passed his remains on to his friends.
rows.quest:5385:progress:0: How did things go in Jaedenar, ⟦47⟧?
rows.quest:5385:completion:0: You've done it! Praise be to ⟦E25⟧ and whichever powers you worshihp, ⟦48⟧. You have done an honorable and noble thing this day. I am certain Arko'narin will be pleased that you not only took the time to save her, but to also slay the creature who tortured one of her best friends.
rows.quest:5385:completion:1: I wish I could do more for you, but please, take this.
rows.quest:4741:obj:0: Trull Failbane in ⟦E4⟧ wants you to hunt 13 Moontouched Owlbeasts.
rows.quest:4741:details:0: In the northern areas of ⟦E15⟧, the Wildkin grow even more ferocious. We must continue our measures there.
rows.quest:4741:details:1: Hunt the moontouched owlbeasts in ⟦E15⟧, and explore the area they inhabit.
rows.quest:4741:details:2: This is dangerous ground, but I know that you will be able to handle the challenge. Return to me after you have slain 13 of the wildkin.
rows.quest:4741:progress:0: Don't tell me that you're too scared! Get going!
rows.quest:4741:completion:0: I sense that you are enjoying your work. And I believe that we are onto something here.
rows.quest:5242:obj:0: Kill Moora and Salia, and bring ⟦E26⟧ to Greta Mosshoof in ⟦E4⟧.
rows.quest:5242:details:0: Unfortunately, I see the only way to stop this ⟦E13⟧ to ⟦E4⟧ is a frontal attack. There are no other ways into ⟦E3⟧ Hold, and I have no means to teleport you inside. The straight path down to the bottom is the only way... and I also know who you should seek out. His name is Fel'dan... ⟦E3⟧ Lord Fel'dan. He is the mortal in power down below... he is the head of the serpent. Kill him and his two succubus servants and return to me. Fel'dan is the one making pacts with the Legion. He must be stopped.
rows.quest:5242:progress:0: Without Fel'dan, the ⟦E2⟧ will hopefully lose focus and start infighting. They will struggle with one another for control and hoard assets for future plans. That will be an opportune time to devastate them and their ⟦E27⟧ slaves.
rows.quest:5242:completion:0: Earthmother be praised, ⟦49⟧! Thank you! This is a great day, indeed!
rows.quest:5242:completion:1: The ⟦E2⟧ will be hard pressed to scale to the same levels of power they once held with this blow to their hierarchy. You have done a great thing this day!
rows.quest:4721:obj:0: Trull Failbane in ⟦E4⟧ wants you to hunt 10 ⟦E28⟧ Owlbeasts in ⟦E15⟧.
rows.quest:4721:details:0: Runners have returned from ⟦E15⟧ with reports that there is a series of small caves in the southern area of ⟦E15⟧. It seems that there are wildkin situated in the area around these caves. If there is something valuable that they are guarding, I believe that this is the place we will find it.
rows.quest:4721:details:1: You will find these to be more of a challenge than the previous types, ⟦50⟧. The creatures seem to have gone mad from exposure to the very thing that they strive to protect.
rows.quest:4721:completion:0: Hard work is something I have great respect for, ⟦52⟧. Now we can move forward with our plans for ⟦E15⟧.
